name: Cachi
description: Perfumery, liquor and food shop in Montevideo with an online store on WooCommerce. Sells perfumes, drinks, infusions, food, chocolate, cosmetics, gifts and homeware. States same-day dispatch to interior agencies and free shipping above a stated amount; nationwide coverage is not stated.
description_es: Perfumería, licorería y almacén de Montevideo con tienda online sobre WooCommerce. Vende perfumes, bebidas, infusiones, alimentos, chocolate, cosmética, regalos y bazar. Indica despacho el mismo día a agencias del interior y envío gratis por encima de un monto indicado; la cobertura nacional no figura.

ships_to.notes: Same-day dispatch to interior agencies; nationwide coverage not stated explicitly.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists a Montevideo store (Julio Herrera y Obes 1397); web-order pickup not stated.

sources.supports: interior dispatch to agencies, free-shipping threshold, categories
